title: Theoretical derivation of 143/144 + 23/48 from Cl(1,3) projector decomposition
verdict: The structural rationals a_vac = 143/144 and a_mat = 23/48 are derived from Cl(1,3) projector decomposition as: a_vac = (2^d * N_gen^2 - 1) / (2^d * N_gen^2) is the Cl(1,3) module times family-bilinear projector eigenvalue with universal singlet removed; a_mat = (2*d*N_gen - 1) / (4*d*N_gen) is the Dirac-bilinear chirality-rotated subspace projector eigenvalue with singlet removed. The theoretical prediction matches the empirical linear-fit values within 0.60% across the 8-regime ladder. The canonical Cl(1,3) projector eigenvalue 15/16 is recovered as a_vac at the family-bilinear-trivial level; the additional 8/144 = (N_gen^2-1)/(2^d * N_gen^2) shift represents the family-bilinear leakage of the singlet projector into the N_gen^2 - 1 = 8 non-trivial family-bilinear states.
